01The flow

Five emails. Think of them as five cards.

Every customer who finishes sign-up but never puts money in gets these five, spread over a week. Click any card to read it.

02Two groups

Same five cards. Two different orders.

Split SEA customers down the middle into Group A and Group B. Both groups get all five cards on the same five days. The only thing that changes is which card lands on which day.

01 Copy Trading
 
Dear %%first_name%%,
Picking your first trade is the hardest part. So don’t pick it alone.
TMGM Copy Trading mirrors the positions of experienced traders into your account automatically. Browse verified performance histories, choose a strategy that matches your risk appetite, and your account follows in real time.
You stay in control. Stop, switch or adjust whenever you want.
It is the fastest route from a funded account to an active one.
Explore Copy Trading
Verified track records · Stop or switch anytime
 
02 What’s included
 
And when you want to trade your own way
 Trading Central: daily technical signals and trade ideas in plain language
Acuity Analytics: AI-driven sentiment and live news mapped onto your charts
MT4 and MT5: the platforms you already know, on desktop, web and mobile
Forex VPS: keep automated strategies running 24/5 without leaving a device on
Live webinars: strategy sessions with market analysts
